overview_description.description: R Games is a blockchain-based racing gaming platform that combines traditional racing gameplay with Web3 features such as NFTs, play-to-earn mechanics, and crypto token integration. The project positions itself as an AI-powered racing ecosystem featuring multiple game modes, customizable vehicles, and a virtual garage for managing in-game assets.

about_short_description.short_description: R Games is a blockchain-based racing gaming platform.

product.name: R-modes
product.description: A collection of racing game modes including story mode, street racing, Formula-R, demolishing mode, and off-road racing, each with distinct environments and gameplay mechanics.

product.name: R-garage
product.description: A 3D interactive virtual garage where players can view, manage, customize, and upgrade their in-game vehicles.

product.name: $RGAME Token
product.description: A blockchain-based token used within the R Games ecosystem for staking, farming incentives, and in-game economy transactions.

product.name: Play-to-Earn (P2E) Mechanics
product.description: Game mechanics that allow players to earn rewards and tokens through gameplay and achievements.

product.name: Multiplayer Mode
product.description: A game mode allowing players to compete against others globally with features like a server browser and friendly races.

product.name: NFT Integration
product.description: Integration of non-fungible tokens (NFTs) for vehicle ownership, customization, and trading within the game.
